entry.name: gen_dsp_sah
entry.description: The first inlet is the 'input' and the second inlet is the 'control'. When the control makes a transition from being at or below the trigger value to being above the trigger threshold, the input is sampled. The sampled value is output until another control transition occurs, at which point the input is sampled again. The default threshold value is 0, but can be specified as the last inlet/argument. The @init attribute sets the initial previous value to compare to (default 0).
